title: The Workroom
why: Wendell's answer on wa-world-door-intake-1 (2026-11-23, C): the generated worlds stay sealed and one world is his to draw in, in WorkAdventure's own map editor.

pieces.floor: a plank floor across the whole room, so every tile can be stood on and drawn over
pieces.walls: a stone wall one tile thick around the edge, with a doorway in the south wall
pieces.workbench: a bench of eight table tiles along the north wall, where a piece being built is laid out
pieces.stage: an eight by six empty square in the middle, left bare on purpose: this is the room's drawing space
pieces.door_south: the way back to the Lantern Walk, as an exitUrl area two tiles wide

rules: The generator seeds this map once. It refuses to overwrite workroom.tmj unless it is run with --seed, because the client's editor is the author after the seed.
workroom.wam is what makes the room editable: WorkAdventure's editor and its map list both need a WAM file beside the map.
Areas and entities drawn in the client live in workroom.wam, not in this file.
